verified: edh-c-59 review (Commander lane edh-c, EDHREC ranks 20,001-20,500, second pass), by hand against the Oracle text, the rulings and the Comprehensive Rules of 2026-09-25: the cost of the first kicked spell its controller casts each turn is reduced by {1} (CR 601.2f, 702.33d): the reduction applies max(0, 1 minus the kicked spells that player cast earlier this turn) times, and the history keeps whether a cast spell was kicked (cm.t32.first.spell.each.turn.less, now with the kicked fact); the second ability is a cast trigger on a kicked spell that puts a +1/+1 counter on the Gecko.
